description: Single source-of-truth registry for Chris Izworski's Michigan & Great Lakes Field Guides. Used by /guides/, /tools/, and scripts/verify-field-guides.mjs.

guides.title: Michigan Winter Weekend Getaways
guides.subtitle: 12 2-Day Base Towns · Snow Trails + Weather-Proof Backups
guides.summary: 12 researched 2-day Michigan winter base towns from Marquette, Munising, the Keweenaw, and Ironwood to Traverse City, Petoskey, Gaylord, Alpena, Frankenmuth, and Saugatuck—each pairing a Saturday outdoor anchor with a no-snow indoor backup.

guides.title: Michigan White Christmas & Christmas-Week Escapes
guides.subtitle: 10 Holiday Base Towns · NOAA 1991–2020 Snow Odds + Backups
guides.summary: Compare 10 Michigan Christmas-week escape towns ranked by NOAA 1991–2020 1-inch snow-depth probability (~96% Marquette to 45.7% Frankenmuth), resort snowmaking insurance, holiday lights, and mild-December backup plans.

guides.title: Michigan First Snow Adventures
guides.subtitle: 12 Early-Winter Snowbelts · Lake-Effect Physics & Grass-Bed Trails
guides.summary: Where winter arrives first in Michigan: 12 high-elevation Lake Superior and Northern Lower snowbelt stops with grass-bed Nordic trail thresholds (2–4" vs. 12"), early snowmaking hills, and bare-ground hike backups.

guides.title: Great Lakes Winter Freighter & Harbor Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Shoreline Viewing Hubs · Final Lock Push, Layups & Icebreakers
guides.summary: 12 public Great Lakes harbors and lock overlooks for late-season freighter passages, the Jan 15–Mar 25 Soo Locks winter closure, 1,000-footer winter layup berths, and USCG icebreaker operations.

guides.title: Michigan Winter Activities Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 18 Curated Experiences · Snowshoeing, Luge, Waterfalls & Dark Skies
guides.summary: 18 source-backed winter experiences across both peninsulas covering snowshoeing, frozen waterfalls, fat-tire biking, winter wildlife, downhill and XC skiing, Muskegon luge, and dark-sky stargazing.

guides.title: Frozen Michigan: Ice Caves, Waterfalls & Shorelines
guides.subtitle: 11 Winter Ice Wonders · Formation Evidence & Safe Shore Access
guides.summary: 11 researched Michigan winter ice destinations—Eben Ice Caves, Pictured Rocks ice curtains, Upper Tahquamenon Falls, Bond Falls, Laughing Whitefish, and Straits ice—with official access rules and live cold-trend handoffs.

guides.title: Michigan Winter Trails: Snowshoe, XC Ski & Fat-Bike Loops
guides.subtitle: 15 Trail Systems · 50 Named Loops · Track Etiquette & Plow Rules
guides.summary: 15 audited Michigan winter trail systems and 50 named DNR/NPS loops with snowshoe vs. groomed ski track etiquette, Silver Lake's Dec 15–Mar 15 fat-bike season, and seasonal unplowed road warnings.

guides.title: Northern Michigan Wine, Cider & Spirits
guides.subtitle: 18 Anchor Venues + 102-Venue Crosswalk · Heated Igloos & Fireside Flights
guides.summary: 18 anchor wineries, heritage cideries, and craft distilleries across Old Mission, Leelanau, Traverse City, and Petoskey/Walloon Lake—with heated winter domes, vineyard snowshoe loops, and 5:00 PM distillery handoffs.
